name: EPFL - Ecole polytechnique federale de Lausanne
summary: Swiss federal institute of technology on Lake Geneva; bachelor's taught mainly in French, with first-year places capped at 3,000.

ib.text: HL Maths (AA or AI), HL Physics and HL chemistry, biology or computer science; 38/42 with 6 in Maths and Physics. IB applicants are ranked on points. French at B2 required, C1 recommended.

dates.label: Application form submitted and fee paid (same date every year)
School certificate and transcripts uploaded (same date every year)
Final proof of your diploma, or admission is cancelled (same date every year)

notes: First-year places are capped at 3,000 from 2025 for at least four years, and IB holders hear at the beginning of August whether they got one.
Most bachelor's courses are in French; from the second year up to half can be in English.
If you have not studied French at school, you must attest your level when you apply, by 30 April.
